verdict.rationale: Follow Up Boss documents its own automation features: Action Plans that automate follow-up, automated personalized emails, texts and calls, rule-based lead distribution, and an Automations object that the API can trigger. These are first-party capabilities that act on leads without manual steps, but the evidence is short marketing lines and API endpoint names, with no detail on how background triggers are configured or run. Missing for 10: documentation of automation trigger and scheduling setup, evidence of fully autonomous event-driven execution, AI-driven or agentic automation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Automate follow up with Action Plans
Automate personalized emails, texts, and calls for all your prospects, so you can focus on your hottest, high-potential leads.
Manually trigger an Automation for a specified Person.
round robin, first to claim, and rules by price or ZIP code
